news.headline: NWS Melbourne Mon Nov 23, 2:49 PM: Flood Watch issued for the Treasure Coast, Brevard and Okeechobee from 1 AM Wednesday through 1 AM Thursday; River Flood Warnings remain in effect for the St. Johns River at Cocoa, Geneva, Astor, DeLand and Sanford — all five points in Major Flood Stage or forecast to reach it, with prolonged flooding expected and additional rises possible from mid-week rain

Namdar Group lands $345 million construction loan to build West Brickell rental tower — Commercial Observer: the SCALE Lending loan covers a 42-story, 871,000-square-foot tower at 250 Southwest Seventh Street in Miami with 1,008 apartments, filed under Florida's Live Local Act, completion expected May 2029

Miami Beach rejects 38-story Live Local towers at Southgate — the city ruled the 910 West Avenue site ineligible for the Live Local Act, blocking a plan for a pair of 38-story towers with 442 units, including 178 workforce rentals

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Comex copper settles 2.74% higher at $5.6270 on Mon Nov 23 — front-month copper for November delivery gained 15.00 cents a pound, settling at $5.6270 after roaring back from a bear market in early trade

HVAC manufacturers report increased Q3 revenue — ACHR News Nov 23: Carrier, Trane Technologies and Lennox posted improved residential and commercial revenue, data centers are driving commercial demand with Johnson Controls reporting record backlogs, and contractors face continued price increases from tariffs and high fuel prices

Stocks climb Mon afternoon Nov 23 on Nvidia rally — WSJ: Nasdaq up 6.8%, S&P 500 up 5% and Dow up 3.3% Monday afternoon, with Nvidia soaring as much as 36% after Jensen Huang's return as chief executive

Mortgage rates today Mon Nov 23 — average 30-year fixed is 7.15%, down 0.05% from yesterday, with the 15-year fixed at 6.32%; the Fed held its benchmark steady Oct 28, its next decision is due Dec 9, and Wednesday's PCE inflation report is the week's big watch

NBA Sun Nov 22 — Miami Heat beat the Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 at Kaseya Center, Bam Adebayo posting a triple-double with 24 points, 15 rebounds and 12 assists for Miami's seventh straight win; Orlando Magic lost at the Washington Wizards 116-96

NFL Week 11 Sun Nov 22 — all three Florida teams lost: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants upset the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18; next up Sun Nov 29, Jaguars host the Titans and Dolphins host the Jets
